description:
MCPServer is an MCP server that AI Agents of an environment can use.
metadata.name is its slug, which AI Agents refer to it by. How an agent
signs in to the server is set on the agent's link to it, not here.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: MCPServerSpec is how to reach an MCP server.

args.description: Args of the command, for stdio.

command.description: Command to run, required for stdio.

displayName.description:
DisplayName is the server's name in the dashboard. It defaults to
metadata.name, and is unique within the environment.

type.description: Type of connection. It defaults to http.

url.description:
URL of the endpoint. The Control Plane requires one for every type,
and checks it is a public HTTPS address unless the host is trusted.

status.description: MCPServerStatus is the Control Plane's view of an MCP server.

connection.description:
Connection is the result of the last connection: unknown, active or
error.

creationSource.description: CreationSource records how the resource was created: ui, api or gitops.

gitOpsOwner.description:
GitOpsOwner is the GitOps agent that owns the resource. While it is set,
the resource is read-only everywhere else.

agentId.description: AgentID is the authoritative identifier of the owning agent.

agentName.description: AgentName is for display only, and may be stale after a rename.

id.description: ID is the Control Plane's identifier of the resource.

lastConnectedAt.description: LastConnectedAt is when the server was last reached.

lastError.description: LastError is the error of the last failed connection.

lastModificationSource.description:
LastModificationSource records how the resource was last changed: ui,
api or gitops.
